m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read inherited global doctrine (global-crew.md, global-everyone.md), the checklist-engine reference, the handoff, and the g1/g2/g3 deliverables + segment_map derivation + frozen_constants that g4 composes. Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, evidence, test mode, stop conditions). Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + engine ref + handoff + g1/g2/g3/derivation sources loaded; handoff complete

m1-script.title: Season-capable build CLI composing g1/g2/g3 + derivation
m1-script.imperative: Create scripts/build_class_utilization_observables.py mirroring #628: load_store_df -> per-round -> derive SegmentMap live (derive-from-pool, one session load) -> per-constructor build_car_ceiling(strictly_pre=True)+simulate_lap -> compose ReferenceLapProduct (g2) + per-driver ClassUtilizationObservable (g3) -> persist to OWN db via ReferenceUtilizationStore. Season-capable (--year --session-type --rounds --drivers), resumable/idempotent, error-rows never crash the batch, timestamped, pinned-interpreter-safe. Factor a pure compose/persist seam + a pure load-weekend-inputs seam so the smoke test needs no real data. G soft-degrades (grip store absent -> grip=None).

postconditions.statement: script imports clean and --help runs under the pinned interpreter

m2-validation-helper.title: Pure jackknife/validation helper module
m2-validation-helper.imperative: Create src/physics/utilization/class_utilization_validation.py: pure math for the delete-d/block boundary-jitter jackknife -- boundary_set_drift_m (symmetric nearest-neighbour boundary drift, anchored to MAP_STABILITY_DRIFT_M), per-class deficit stability across replicates (spread/IQR), and a positive_control that injects a corner deficit shifted into a straight class and confirms the robustness statistic FLAGS it (literal-free contrast vs the clean baseline). No DB/session I/O.

postconditions.statement: helper imports clean under the pinned interpreter

constraints: no new literal acceptance band (anchor to MAP_STABILITY_DRIFT_M only)
soft membership, not argmax collapse, for attribution

m3-smoke-test.title: CLI smoke test on synthetic + temp DB + artifact contract
m3-smoke-test.imperative: Create tests/unit/physics/test_build_class_utilization_observables.py: build a synthetic SegmentMap + synthetic lap pool + synthetic v_ideal/v_real, exercise the pure compose/persist seam against a temp own-db (asserts rows + idempotent rerun no-dup), run the jackknife helper on a synthetic fixture and assert the artifact contract keys + a FIRED positive control. Test-after/inspection: observe green under pinned pytest.

postconditions.statement: the smoke test passes under the pinned interpreter

constraints: synthetic + temp DB only (no real data in the unit test)

m4-bounded-run.title: Bounded real validation slice + gating jackknife artifact
m4-bounded-run.imperative: Run the bounded slice FOREGROUND/in-turn (2023 Q, 1 circuit -- shrink not detach if >~10min), both top constructors' drivers, budget op-count first. Produce .agent-work/664-reference-laps/artifacts/jackknife_attribution.json (+ short .md) with: real per-class deficit stability numbers, B in [20,50], positive-control FIRED, MAP_STABILITY_DRIFT_M anchor, G soft-degrade note, anti-circularity note. Attest c1 with the console tail + fresh-artifact stat + wall-clock.

postconditions.statement: bounded run completed foreground within the bound; jackknife_attribution.json is fresh with real stability numbers + FIRED positive control + required notes

m5-idempotency-finalize.title: Idempotent rerun + write IMPLEMENTER_RESULT
m5-idempotency-finalize.imperative: Confirm idempotent CLI rerun (no dup rows), confirm deliverables are committed-path (git check-ignore exits 1 for script+helper+test) while artifacts stay under .agent-work. Re-run the pinned smoke test green. Write IMPLEMENTER_RESULT to crew-results/g4-implement-result.md. Attest c1 (final green + idempotency evidence).

postconditions.statement: smoke test green on rerun and IMPLEMENTER_RESULT written
